# Scheduling

1 route. Base URL: `https://orbitwrite.com/api/v1`. Paths below are absolute.

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/v1/scheduling/suggestions` | Suggested publish times per channel |

### GET /api/v1/scheduling/suggestions

Suggested publish times per channel

Candidate times to schedule a post at, one entry per connected channel. The slot strategies return the workspace's configured posting slots that nothing is scheduled on yet — the same placement the composer's queue makes, so a caller and the calendar agree on which slots are free. `best-time` instead ranks a static, research-informed engagement profile for the platform; it is a heuristic, not measured analytics (`researched` says whether the platform has a profile of its own or the generic fallback). Requires `postingSchedule:read` and `account:read`; the slot strategies also require `post:read`, since occupancy is post data.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | no | Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace. |
| `accountIds` | one of (string | array of string) | no | Repeat to scope to particular channels. Omitted means every connected channel in the workspace. |
| `strategy` | one of `"first-available"` | `"queue"` | `"best-time"` | no | `first-available` (default) takes the soonest free slot; `queue` appends after everything already booked, so a run of posts keeps its order; `best-time` ignores the configured schedule and ranks the platform's engagement profile. |
| `count` | integer (min 1, max 10) | no | Candidates per channel. Defaults to 1. |
| `after` | string (date-time) | no | Search from this instant instead of now — for planning a batch beyond what is already scheduled. |

**Responses**

- `200` — Suggested times, one entry per channel
  - `TimeSuggestionList`
    - `suggestions`: array of `AccountTimeSuggestion`, required
      - `accountId`: string, required
      - `platform`: string, required
      - `timezone`: string, required — IANA zone the times were placed in — the workspace's, falling back to the channel's and then UTC.
      - `times`: array of `SuggestedTime`, required — Soonest first for the slot strategies, strongest first for best-time. Empty when the channel has no free slot inside the two-week lookahead.
        - `at`: string, required — ISO 8601 instant to schedule at.
        - `source`: one of `"slot"` | `"best-time"`, required — `slot` — a configured posting slot with nothing on it. `best-time` — a peak cell of the platform's engagement profile.
      - `reason`: string | null, required — Why these times, for a best-time answer. Null for the slot strategies, where the reason is the workspace's own configuration.
      - `researched`: boolean, required — Whether `reason` reflects a profile researched for this platform or the generic fallback window. Best-time data is a heuristic either way — there is no per-account analytics behind it yet, so do not report it to a person as measured engagement.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`
